address: 1755 John F Kennedy Causeway, Miami, FL 33141
amenitiesDescription:
Over 60,000 square feet of amenities anchored by a destination waterfront restaurant with indoor/outdoor dining, resident charging privileges, private event catering, and in-residence and poolside dining on weekends. The Continuum Marketplace is restocked daily with wine and snacks. The pool level features a waterfront resort pool with cabana seating overlooking Indian Creek, a garden sunpool, and a bayfront jacuzzi plunge nestled in lush landscaping by Martha Schwartz Partners.

A private yacht club and watersports dock with paddleboards and kayaks connect residents directly to Biscayne Bay. The wellness program includes a state-of-the-art 3,500 SF fitness center, yoga and movement studio, and a full-service spa with cryotherapy chamber, infrared sauna, steam room, and private treatment rooms. Social spaces include a 6,000 SF rooftop sundeck with adult pool, soaking spa, and outdoor bar, a waterfront boardroom with A/V, an executive co-working lounge, and outdoor garden cabanas with WiFi. The Island Walk — a landscaped waterfront promenade — frames the entire bayfront edge. Family amenities include a children's art zone and playroom, outdoor splash pad, arcade and virtual lounge, and an outdoor glamping retreat. Pet amenities include an indoor dog wash and spa, indoor Companions Lounge, and a covered outdoor dog park. Building services include a Tesla house car, 24/7 concierge and valet, secured e-bike storage, and a Resident App for amenity bookings, concierge requests, and package management.
description: Phase One of the Continuum Waterfront District. Delivery Q1 2028.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Continuum Club & Residences West is the value play of the current cycle: a full-amenity waterfront building with Sub-Zero/Wolf kitchens, 20-slip district marina, and resort-level lifestyle at a starting price under $1M. North Bay Village's bayfront location between Miami and Miami Beach has been undervalued for decades, and the master-planned Continuum Waterfront District is the first project positioned to change that. With approximately half of 236 residences under contract and a $350 million S3 Capital financing package closed in May 2026 ($261M construction + $83M Phase Two predevelopment), the market and institutional capital have both validated the thesis. For buyers priced out of Miami Beach or Brickell waterfront but unwilling to compromise on views and lifestyle, this is the answer.

investmentThesis:
Phase One of the master-planned Continuum Waterfront District — a 4-acre Biscayne Bay assemblage acquired for approximately $108.5 million between 2023 and 2024, approved under a North Bay Village special area plan in 2025. In May 2026, Continuum Company and Aksoy Holdings closed a $350 million S3 Capital financing package: $261 million in construction financing for this tower and $83 million in predevelopment financing for Phase Two (Continuum Club & Residences East at 1819 JFK Causeway) — a separate ~300-unit condominium with a 96-room hotel and 114 furnished hotel residences targeted for 2030. KAST Construction is the general contractor.

The first luxury branded condo in North Bay Village since its 2020 rezoning, and the second Continuum-branded project following Continuum South Beach — one of the most appreciating residential addresses in Miami. North Bay Village sits at the intersection of only three roadways connecting Miami and Miami Beach, placing residents within 5 minutes of the beach and 15 minutes of the Design District, Bal Harbour Shops, and top-rated private schools. The island is undergoing approximately $2 billion in new investment. At contract signing, buyers receive a Private Yacht Club Membership (fleet of 50'–100' yachts, three half-day excursions included, priority weekend booking), VIP Beach Club Membership with access at Ocean Terrace Beach Club, Collins Park, and South of Fifth, and a Dorsia Premium Membership for priority reservations at the world's most sought-after restaurants across 20+ global markets.
name: Continuum Club & Residences
residenceContent:
Four collections — Bay Lofts, Tower Residences, Sky Residences, and Penthouses — oriented along the curvilinear Arquitectonica facade to maximize sunrise-to-sunset water exposure from every home. Ceiling heights range from 9 to 14 feet, with floor-to-ceiling impact-resistant glass opening to private wraparound terraces overlooking Biscayne Bay, Indian Creek, and the Downtown Miami skyline.

Kitchens feature Sub-Zero and Wolf integrated appliance packages — electric cooktop, wall oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, microwave, and wine fridge in select residences — alongside custom European cabinetry, quartz countertops, and waterfall-edge culinary islands. Primary bathrooms are marble-clad with five-fixture layouts, dual rainfall showerheads, arched double-sink vanities with Dornbracht fittings, and glass-enclosed wet rooms with bay views in select homes. Every residence includes an in-unit laundry room with full-size washer and dryer, double walk-in closets in all primary bedrooms, and wide-plank European wood flooring throughout living areas.
